column4: css_template
column5: checklist

column3: Primary button — ink on cream, soft offset shadow, tactile press
column4: padding: 12px 24px; background: var(--pt-ink); color: var(--pt-cream); border: none; border-radius: 4px; font-family: var(--pt-serif); font-weight: 500; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 0 var(--pt-shadow); transition: transform 100ms ease-out, box-shadow 100ms ease-out;
column5: ☐ AA contrast ☐ active state: translate(1px,1px) + smaller shadow ☐ visible focus ring ☐ 44x44 touch min

column3: Pressed state — translate + smaller offset shadow
column4: transform: translate(1px, 1px); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 0 var(--pt-shadow);
column5: ☐ tactile press feedback ☐ no scale jump ☐ reduced-motion freezes

column3: Page ground — warm cream, never pure white
column4: background: var(--pt-cream); color: var(--pt-ink);
column5: ☐ ground not #fff ☐ AA contrast body ☐ warm undertone (oklch chroma ≥0.02)

column3: Feature card — cream surface, offset shadow, hairline border
column4: padding: 24px; background: var(--pt-cream-elev); border: 1px solid var(--pt-rule); border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 0 var(--pt-shadow);
column5: ☐ offset (not soft-glow) shadow ☐ tactile lift on hover ☐ no soft chromatic shadow

column3: Display headline — serif, ink, restrained tracking
column4: font-family: var(--pt-serif); font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 5rem); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -0.015em; color: var(--pt-ink);
column5: ☐ serif loaded ☐ line-height 1.0-1.1 ☐ AA contrast

column3: Body prose — serif, generous leading
column4: font-family: var(--pt-serif-text); font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.65; max-width: 65ch; color: var(--pt-ink);
column5: ☐ max 65ch ☐ line-height 1.6-1.7 ☐ AA contrast

column3: Hero — cream ground, serif headline, asymmetric grid
column4: display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr; gap: 48px; padding-block: 96px 64px; align-items: end;
column5: ☐ no hero-metric template ☐ no decorative chromatic graphic ☐ single CTA

column3: Top nav — cream ground, hairline rule, serif wordmark
column4: display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; padding: 20px 32px; background: var(--pt-cream); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--pt-rule);
column5: ☐ semantic <nav> ☐ skip-link ☐ baseline alignment ☐ AA contrast

column3: Text input — inset cream surface, hairline border
column4: padding: 10px 14px; background: var(--pt-cream-inset); color: var(--pt-ink); font-family: var(--pt-serif-text); font-size: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--pt-rule); border-radius: 4px;
column5: ☐ font-size ≥16px iOS ☐ focus deepens border + adds inset shadow ☐ AA contrast

column3: Data table — hairline rules, serif body, tabular-nums
column4: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: var(--pt-serif-text); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 15px; color: var(--pt-ink);
column5: ☐ tabular-nums ☐ hairline rules ☐ AA contrast ☐ no chromatic zebra

column3: Section divider — soft repeating dot pattern, paper edge
column4: height: 4px; background-image: radial-gradient(circle, var(--pt-rule) 1px, transparent 1.2px); background-size: 8px 4px; background-repeat: repeat-x; margin-block: 56px;
column5: ☐ semantic <hr> ☐ pattern not soft-glow ☐ aria-hidden if decorative

column3: Status badge — small offset shadow, serif
column4: display: inline-flex; padding: 4px 10px; background: var(--pt-cream-elev); color: var(--pt-ink); font-family: var(--pt-serif-text); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid var(--pt-rule); border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 0 var(--pt-shadow);
column5: ☐ semantic colour + text ☐ offset shadow (not soft-glow) ☐ AA contrast

column3: Modal — cream card, offset shadow, generous padding
column4: padding: 40px; background: var(--pt-cream-elev); border: 1px solid var(--pt-rule); border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 0 var(--pt-shadow); max-width: 520px;
column5: ☐ focus-trap ☐ ESC closes ☐ offset shadow not soft-glow ☐ AA contrast

column3: Pull-quote — serif italic, hairline rules, generous block
column4: margin-block: 48px; padding-block: 24px; border-block: 1px solid var(--pt-rule); font-family: var(--pt-serif); font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.3; font-style: italic; color: var(--pt-ink);
column5: ☐ semantic <blockquote> ☐ italic loaded ☐ no glyph quotes ☐ AA contrast

column3: Image caption — italic serif, small
column4: margin-top: 8px; font-family: var(--pt-serif-text); font-size: 13px; font-style: italic; color: var(--pt-ink-muted);
column5: ☐ semantic <figcaption> ☐ AA contrast ☐ italic loaded

column3: Footer — cream ground, hairline top rule, serif
column4: padding-block: 64px 40px; background: var(--pt-cream); border-top: 1px solid var(--pt-rule); font-family: var(--pt-serif-text);
column5: ☐ semantic <footer> ☐ multi-column responsive ☐ AA contrast

column3: Prose list — serif, hanging bullets
column4: font-family: var(--pt-serif-text); font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.65; padding-left: 1.5em;
column5: ☐ semantic <ul>/<ol> ☐ hanging bullets ☐ items breathe

column3: Icon — stroke-only, slight ink imperfection feel
column4: width: 24px; height: 24px; stroke: var(--pt-ink-muted); fill: none; stroke-width: 1.5;
column5: ☐ stroke not fill ☐ aria-hidden if decorative ☐ AA contrast

column3: Tactile offset shadow — hard offset, not soft-glow
column4: box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 0 var(--pt-shadow);
column5: ☐ offset hard shadow (no blur) ☐ never combine with soft-glow ☐ reduced-motion stable

column3: Focus ring — ink outline with offset
column4: outline: 2px solid var(--pt-ink); outline-offset: 2px;
column5: ☐ visible on all interactive ☐ AA contrast ☐ offset for visibility
